procedures.name: CalcLineTotal
procedures.doc: Calculates the total amount for a VAT statement line based on configured calculation rules. Processes VAT entries and G/L accounts according to line type and formula settings.

procedures.name: CalcLineTotalWithBase
procedures.doc: Calculates both total amount and total base for a VAT statement line with detailed VAT calculations. Processes VAT entries and G/L accounts to determine both VAT amount and base amount components.

procedures.name: InitializeRequest
procedures.doc: Initializes VAT statement report parameters with standard configuration options. Sets up report context including VAT statement template, selection criteria, and formatting preferences.

procedures.name: InitializeRequest
procedures.doc: Initializes VAT statement report parameters with country/region filtering capability. Extended version including geographic filtering for multi-country VAT reporting scenarios.

procedures.name: OnCalcLineTotalOnBeforeCalcTotalAmountVATEntryTotaling
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating total amounts for VAT entry totaling lines. Enables custom calculation logic and amount modifications before standard VAT entry processing.

procedures.name: OnCalcLineTotalOnBeforeCalcTotalAmountAccountTotaling
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating total amounts for G/L account totaling lines. Enables custom calculation logic and amount modifications before standard G/L account processing.

procedures.name: OnCalcLineTotalOnVATEntryTotalingOnAfterVATEntrySetFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters on VAT entries for VAT entry totaling calculations. Enables additional filter modifications or custom VAT entry selection logic.

procedures.name: OnCalcLineTotalWithBaseOnCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for custom VAT statement line types not handled by standard calculation logic. Enables implementation of custom totaling and calculation methods for extended line types.

procedures.name: OnCalcLineTotalWithBaseOnAfterGLAccSetFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters on G/L accounts for account totaling calculations. Enables additional filter modifications or custom G/L account selection logic.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetAmtRoundingDirection
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after determining amount rounding direction for VAT statement calculations. Enables custom rounding direction logic based on specific business requirements.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCalcLineTotalWithBase
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating VAT statement line totals with base amounts. Enables complete override of line total calculation logic with custom implementations.
